symptom: 10 of 21 SFX graphs were refused at POST /prompt validation: 'Value 0.7 smaller than min of 1.0' on EmptyLatentAudio.seconds (cues asked 0.6-0.9 s). The guarded helper wrote submit-rejected.json and the receipt dir could not be reused (dispatch-intent.json exists).
root_cause: EmptyLatentAudio declares seconds min 1.0 (comfy_extras/nodes_audio.py); the cue spec used real action lengths.
fix_or_workaround: Clamp requested seconds to >= 1.0 in the cue spec (clip trimmed at mix time), rebuild graphs, re-run into receipts/<clip>-r2; finish_sfx prefers the -r2 receipt; old rejected receipts kept as evidence.
prevention: Validate every widget against /object_info min/max before submit (the engine's graph builder should assert seconds >= 1.0); keep sub-second cue lengths in the cue sheet as duration_s, not in the latent.
